_doc: Authored by author_clips.py (rerun it after editing the helpers); build_tutor.py reads this file.
keys[bone] = [[t, {loc, rot, scale}, ease?], ...] in three.js axes; .L = his left = +x.
loc = offset from the bone rest position (model units, body radius 0.8); rot = degrees (Euler XYZ) added to rest; scale = multiplier.
A channel used by any key of a bone is keyed at every key of that bone; a key that omits it is at rest there.
ease = how motion ARRIVES at the key: linear | bezier | constant | back | bounce | elastic.
Rotations between consecutive keys must differ by < 180 deg per axis (split big spins).
Loops: first key == last key. Never translate root in x/z.

clips.name: idle
clips.notes: Breathing float: slow bob and sway, hands drift out of phase.

clips.name: talk
clips.notes: Explaining: nods on the beat, his left hand (viewer right) gestures, the other bobs. All eased.

clips.name: think
clips.notes: Hand on chin (taps it), looks up and to the viewer left.

clips.name: listen
clips.notes: Head tilted, two little nods, hand cupped up by his side.

clips.name: point_left
clips.notes: Points viewer left (notes window): holds, one smooth reach, glances back at the viewer explaining, turns back. 4.8 s, all eased.

clips.name: point_right
clips.notes: Points viewer right (board window): holds, one smooth reach, glances back at the viewer explaining, turns back. 4.8 s, all eased.

clips.name: walk
clips.notes: Two steps per loop along his facing (+z); the app moves and turns the root.

clips.name: sleep
clips.notes: Slumped and breathing, cap slid over his eyes.

clips.name: wave
clips.notes: Big friendly wave with his left hand (viewer right), little dip first.

clips.name: hop
clips.notes: Crouch, spring up, squash on landing, rebound.

clips.name: shrug
clips.notes: Palms up and out with a little lift: gentle "hmm, try again".

clips.name: celebrate
clips.notes: Crouch, jump with a full twirl under raised hands, land, pump both fists.

clips.name: dance_bounce
clips.notes: 8-count groove: bounce on every count, sway, step-touch, clap on 2-4-6-8.

clips.name: dance_spin
clips.notes: Wind-up, a full 360 with arms out, overshoot, ta-da pose.

clips.name: dance_robot
clips.notes: Pop-and-lock: arms snap between poses, head ticks, power-down slump, elastic reboot.

clips.name: giggle
clips.notes: Tickled: fast wiggle, hands over his mouth, little kicks.

clips.name: highfive
clips.notes: Wind back and slap a high five toward the camera (his left hand, viewer right).

clips.name: catch
clips.notes: Hands ready, catch at 0.45 s (absorb), then hold it up proudly.

clips.name: yum
clips.notes: Snack to the mouth, chomp-chomp squash, happy belly rub.

clips.name: levelup
clips.notes: Deep crouch, rocket jump with a spin, cap pops off and twirls back on, power pose, fist pumps, stomps.

clips.name: wake
clips.notes: Starts from the sleep pose: startle hop, big stretch, shake it off.

clips.name: dragged
clips.notes: Grabbed and lifted: stretched 1.10, swings +-7 deg, hands flap, feet dangle and kick (whee!).

clips.name: tumble
clips.notes: Tucked into a ball (squash 0.90-0.94), hands hug the front, feet pulled up, eyes squeezed shut.

clips.name: recover
clips.notes: Lands dizzy (cap askew, stars), wobbles in a circle, head-shake, ta-da with arms up.

clips.name: surprise
clips.notes: Startle stretch 1.12, hops back 0.2, lands on a 0.86 squash, hands up palms out, cap pops.

clips.name: hint
clips.notes: Anticipation dip, "aha!" with the mitten raised like a finger beside the cap, leans in 12 deg and wags it.

clips.name: equip
clips.notes: Reaches up and grabs, pulls it down onto the cap (sparkles), chest-out proud pose with a heel tap.

clips.name: read
clips.notes: Holding the open book in both mittens, bowed 9 deg, head centred and still: slow breath, small page-corner lift.

clips.name: dance_shuffle
clips.notes: Side-step shuffle on 0.25 s beats: lead foot out, trail foot closes, bounce, fists pump, jazz-hands finish.

clips.name: dance_wave
clips.notes: Arm wave: arms out, a ripple rolls hand -> body -> cap -> hand, four passes 0.42 s apart, hands-up finish.

clips.name: dance_floss
clips.notes: Floss on 0.2 s beats: arms whip side to side in front, hips counter-swing, heel pops, hands-up finish.

clips.name: dance_disco
clips.notes: Disco point on 0.25 s beats: up-out, down-across, four per hand, free hand on hip, toe taps, point-up finish.

clips.name: dance_twist
clips.notes: Twist on 0.15 s beats: hips snap +-28 deg, hands swing against them, feet swivel, sinks low and pops back up.

clips.name: emote_laugh
clips.notes: Belly laugh: dip, head thrown back with both mittens on his belly, ha-ha-ha bounces, doubles over with a stomp.

clips.name: emote_shy
clips.notes: Bashful: turns half away with his mittens on his cheeks, sways, scuffs a toe, then sneaks a peek back at the student.

clips.name: emote_doubletake
clips.notes: Double take: casual glance to the viewer left, snaps back with a hop, stretch 1.14, jazz hands and a cap pop, then a wide-eyed stare.

clips.name: emote_fistpump
clips.notes: "Yesss!": cocks his left fist high, yanks it down to his hip with a knee pull and a crunch, a second quick pump, proud hold.

clips.name: emote_facepalm
clips.notes: D'oh: winds up, slaps his right mitten flat across his forehead, slumps forward, slow head-shake under it, drags it down his face.

clips.name: emote_nod
clips.notes: Eager yes: three quick whole-body nods (16, 14, 9 deg) with squash on each, clasped mittens bouncing in front.

clips.name: emote_headshake
clips.notes: Nope: fast no-no shakes (22, 20, 16 deg, decaying), eyes squeezed shut, both mittens wave palms-out against the shake.

clips.name: emote_love
clips.notes: Aww: both mittens pressed over his heart, swoons back, sways side to side with a foot pop, hearts.

clips.name: emote_salute
clips.notes: Ready!: dips, snaps tall (1.08) with a heel click and his right mitten flat at his brow, holds, snaps back down.

clips.name: emote_thumbsup
clips.notes: You got this: winds back, thrusts two thumbs-up at the student with a lean-in, two pumps.

clips.name: play_shoot
clips.notes: Gather at the belly, crouch 0.80, jump 0.45, both hands push the ball up and flick at 0.50 s, land on a 0.84 squash.

clips.name: play_dribble
clips.notes: Two dribbles per loop with his left hand (viewer right): the hand pushes down and lets go at 0.10/0.50 s, the ball bounces at 0.20/0.60 s and is back in the hand at 0.40/0.80 s.

clips.name: play_dunk
clips.notes: Palms the ball (his left hand), two stutter steps, gather 0.76, jump 0.62, reaches high and slams it down at 0.80 s, hangs a beat, lands on a 0.80 squash.

clips.name: play_kick
clips.notes: Steps his right foot in beside the ball, swings his left foot out to the side, strikes at 0.35 s, follows through across his body with a lean back and arms out, steps back to rest.

clips.name: play_juggle
clips.notes: Keepy-uppy: his left foot taps the ball at 0, his right at 0.40 s; the ball arcs across in front of his belly (apex 0.66 at 0.20/0.60 s); he leans over it with arms out for balance.

clips.name: play_catch_throw
clips.notes: Hands up ready, catches the ball at his belly at 0.30 s (absorb squash 0.90), cocks it to his chest and chest-passes it back toward the camera, letting go at 0.65 s with a step in.

clips.name: play_jumprope
clips.notes: Skips over a rope the app draws between his hands: hands at the top of their circles at 0 (rope overhead), at the bottom at 0.25 s while he is in the air (rope under his feet).

rope.phase: rope angle = 360 deg * t / 0.5 s, 0 = overhead, 180 = under his feet (front at 90 deg)

clips.name: tumble_knockback
clips.notes: boss: chest hit (squash), flies back 0.6 onto his back (ring), legs kick at the sky, rocks back up, hops into the tumble tuck.

clips.name: tumble_spin
clips.notes: thrown: cartwheel hop toward his right (full turn in the screen plane, tucked), lands with a ring, windmills, hops into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_spin_l
clips.notes: thrown: cartwheel hop toward his left (full turn in the screen plane, tucked), lands with a ring, windmills, hops into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_splat
clips.notes: dropped: splats to a 0.5 pancake (ring), wobbles flat like a settling coin, pops up tall, jelly settle, hops into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_bonk
clips.notes: bonk: smack, head snaps back with the cap popping (stars), recoils, rubs his head through dizzy circles, legs give, plops onto his bottom, hops into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_dizzy
clips.notes: shaken: two drunk circles with stumbling steps (stars), lurches to his right, flops onto that side (ring), feet twitch, pops up into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_dizzy_l
clips.notes: shaken: two drunk circles with stumbling steps (stars), lurches to his left, flops onto that side (ring), feet twitch, pops up into the tuck.

clips.name: tumble_faceplant
clips.notes: flicked: crouch, front flip toward the camera, faceplant (squash, stars), hands pat the floor, feet flutter above him, pops up into the tuck.
